subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this remain the umbrella tracker while narrower session-lock and subagent-delivery fixes land, or should maintainers split it now into narrower canonical issues and close the umbrella later?
rationale: Current main has partial repairs, but the remaining work crosses bug fixes and product policy for subagent isolation, cancellation, and operator-visible orchestration semantics.

options.title: Keep Umbrella For Now
options.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella and review narrower fixes such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 before reassessing closure.

options.title: Split Into Canonicals
options.body: Promote the remaining lock, delivery, detached-work, and metadata-only design paths into explicit canonical issues, then close this issue only after the split preserves the evidence.

options.title: Sponsor Orchestration Redesign
options.body: Treat this as a larger product design effort for token-ring or metadata-only completion semantics instead of a bug-sweep target.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella For Now
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella and review narrower fixes such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 before reassessing closure.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history and product-boundary signal for session locks, subagents, config mutation, and core orchestration points to steipete.
